reading.passage: Many great artists say that inspiration is everywhere. A leaf, an old story or a childhood memory can all lead to a wonderful new work of art.
reading.passageCn: 许多伟大的艺术家都说,灵感无处不在。一片叶子、一个古老的故事,或一段童年记忆,都可能催生出一件美妙的新艺术作品。

questions.q: According to the passage, what can lead to a new work of art?
opts: Everyday things like a leaf or a memory.

writing.prompt: Write a short invitation (about 60 words) asking a friend to visit a school art festival with you. Mention the time, the place and one artwork you want to see.
writing.promptCn: 写一封约60词的简短邀请,邀请朋友和你一起参观学校艺术节。写清时间、地点,以及一件你想看的作品。

dialogues.title: Inviting a Friend to the Art Festival

lines.text: There's an art festival at school this Friday. Would you like to come with me?
lines.cn: 这周五学校有个艺术节,你想和我一起去吗?

lines.text: I'd love to! What kind of artworks will be there?
lines.cn: 我很乐意!那里会有什么样的作品呢?

lines.text: Paintings, sculptures, and even works made from computer parts. They look amazing.
lines.cn: 有绘画、雕塑,甚至还有用电脑部件做的作品,看起来很惊艳。

lines.text: That sounds inspiring. Let's meet at the school gate at four.
lines.cn: 听起来很有启发。我们四点在校门口见吧。
